mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) over the next 5 trading days predicts stronger corporate earnings and investor confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 trend reverses in the next 5 days, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 2.0% signals labor market strength, boosting corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not fall below 2.0% in the next month, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) indices signals economic expansion, reducing uncertainty and driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 > GDPC1_prev and INDPRO > INDPRO_prev in the same month
failure_condition: Either GDPC1 or INDPRO does not rise in the same month, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, rising FEDFUNDS rates signal higher borrowing costs, reducing corporate profits and equity valuations, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS does not rise above 4.5% in the tightening cycle, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the supply index (INDPRO) below 100 in the next 5 days signals weakening production capacity, leading to negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not drop below 100 in the next 5 days, or 5-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.0%) combined with strong demand (GDPC1 > 250) creates a favorable labor market and robust economic activity, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Either UNRATE or GDPC1 does not meet the threshold, or 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained downward trend in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates improving labor market conditions, boosting corporate profits and investor sentiment, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE trend reverses in the next 60 days, or 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sharp decline in the supply index (INDPRO) below 95 signals overcapacity and potential softening demand, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not drop below 95 in the late-cycle expansion, or 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05).
